criteria.requirement: Fix Validator.validate when-environment inheritance as call-local evaluation context, never persisting an inferred env list onto shared self.when. Respect explicit child envs, nested when/and/or and only_current_env while retaining normal validation behavior. A descriptor first used by disabled dev must still reject negative PORT when enabled prod is checked, exactly as a fresh descriptor would. Concurrent/nested instances must not leak environments or require deepcopy of arbitrary user predicates; reset context on every failure/return.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
